response.overview: Yeon-woo pulls out his wisdom tooth and throws it away. But from his arms, his mouth, and even above his head, wisdom teeth keep appearing, over and over again. They are both welcome and unwanted—repulsive, yet strangely endearing. No matter how far he throws them or how deeply he buries them, they keep coming back to him.  In the end, Yeon-woo buries the wisdom teeth in the ground.  As he falls asleep, a shadow emerges before him. Will Yeon-woo ever be able to escape his wisdom teeth?
response.title: Love, Throw You
